latin: Sacramenta noue legis sunt causa gratiae, non solum sine qua non, sed per quam.

mentions.context: against the opposite view, represented in this case, for instance, by Ockham and Pecham, while committing Thomas to a position which is perhaps just beyond his intentions. We also notice the different terminology used by Pico. Thesis 13 is a declaration concerning the sacraments of the New Testament. It states that these sacraments are the cause of grace not only as an indispen- sable cause, but also as an efficient cause.52 This topic is discussed in Thomas’s commentary on the Sentences, 4, d. 1, q. 1, a. 4.
